title: centratherum aristatum
intro: Centratherum aristatum, commonly known as Jumma grass or Queen's lace, is a flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It is traditionally used for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which have been shown to aid in wound healing and reduce fever. The therapeutic actions of Centratherum aristatum include its ability to inhibit the growth of certain bacteria and fungi, making it a potential natural remedy for infections and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
